source: Department of National Defence operation histories; United Nations Secretary-General reports and The Blue Helmets (UN Digital Library); Veterans Affairs Canada
unit: approximate annual maximum of uniformed personnel concurrently deployed (lower and upper bound)
transformations: mission intervals expanded to months and summed within each category
annual maximum bounded by the largest monthly lower bound and the largest monthly upper bound
peak_month = first month reaching the upper bound; missions = those present in that month
UN-led rows cover 1949–1990; the UN's monthly data takes over from November 1990
notes: Approximate by construction: sources state contingent sizes at dated points, not annual averages; a wide low–high range marks a gap between dated figures, not a larger deployment.
